how.title: How it works
how.sub: Business language on top, the full method one click below.
how.data.title: Data
how.data.plain: Sales, leads, campaigns and indicators for every dealership, month by month.
how.data.tech1: 36 months by dealership, model, trim and color
how.data.tech2: Leads: web + 4 x test drives, lagged 1 month
how.data.tech3: Credit times the segment's financed share
how.model.title: Demand model
how.model.plain: One model per dealership and model that learns season, trend and sales drivers.
how.model.tech1: Negative binomial, log link, penalized IRLS
how.model.tech2: Empirical Bayes: series to segment to group
how.ranges.title: Confidence ranges
how.ranges.plain: Instead of one number, a likely range for every month and level.
how.ranges.tech2: Parameters, indicators, leads and NB noise
how.coherent.title: Numbers that add up
how.coherent.plain: The owner, brand manager and dealership numbers always agree.
how.coherent.tech3: Applied to every path and scenario
how.order.title: Suggested order
how.order.plain: The forecast becomes units to order by trim and color.
how.order.tech2: Safety stock: empirical quantile, no normal
how.order.tech3: Trim and color: multinomial logit with trend
how.btSub: WAPE by level, {n} cutoffs over the last 12 months, 1 to 3 months ahead. Lower is better.
